title: Northwind Health: sync failure returns after password change
transcript:
Agent: Northwind support, this is Elena. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Elena, this is Marcus from Northwind Health. The EHR connector stopped syncing again. It is the same authentication error as before.
Agent: Let me pull up the account and the prior tickets. I see the July 10 token reset and the July 12 full re-authorization. Is this after another password change?
Customer: Yes. IT rotated the service account password on Tuesday. I was hoping the re-authorization would stick this time.
Agent: The history shows the same pattern. The connector drops the token when the service account password changes. I can re-authorize it now, and I want to add a step to your password-change runbook so this does not keep happening.
Customer: That would help. What should the runbook say?
Agent: After the password rotation, go to Settings, then Integrations, then EHR Connector, and choose Disconnect. Then reconnect and authorize. Do not use the refresh option. Wait until the connector status says connected before you close the console.
Customer: Okay. I am doing that now. Disconnected, connected, authorized. The sync is moving again.
Agent: I can see it. I am creating a ticket for this occurrence and scheduling a follow-up for August 22. I will include the runbook steps in the ticket and email them to you.
Customer: Thanks. This is the third time. Is there a permanent fix?
Agent: I am escalating the pattern to our integration team. There may be a configuration change that avoids the token drop, but I do not want to promise it until they review the connector settings.
Customer: Fair enough. Please make sure they see the history.
Agent: They will. The ticket links the July incidents and this one. I will send the follow-up details now.
